title: Senior Strategic Account Executive (Accounts 1 billion+)
description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As a Senior Strategic Account Executive, you own the development and growth of a portfolio of assigned strategic accounts within your designated region. You build and execute strategic sales plans, develop trusted relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders, and identify opportunities to expand Rithum's value across complex client organizations. You are accountable for meeting or exceeding financial targets by leading consultative, value-based sales engagements and securing high-value, multi-year software and services agreements.

Rithum empowers employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to work smarter, move faster, and create scalable ways of working. In this role, you will use AI and data-driven insights to strengthen account strategy, identify opportunities, improve sales effectiveness, and deliver more relevant and impactful client engagement.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Growth

  • Develop and execute account plans aligned to client priorities, commerce strategies, and growth objectives.
  • Meet or exceed sales targets by identifying, developing, and closing software and services opportunities.
  • Expand Rithum’s footprint across client brands, business units, geographies, channels, marketplaces, and capabilities.
  • Build qualified pipeline by identifying whitespace and new opportunities within assigned accounts.

Executive & Value-Based Selling

  • Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders.
  • Understand client priorities and position Rithum’s capabilities against business outcomes.
  • Lead consultative, value-based conversations and develop compelling business cases.
  • Navigate complex buying groups and build consensus across decision-makers.

Deal Execution

  • Lead complex sales opportunities from discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Develop deal strategies that address client priorities, competitive dynamics, commercial considerations, and barriers to close.
  • Lead negotiations across pricing, terms, procurement, legal, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Apply the Rithum Way of Selling to opportunity strategy, qualification, progression, and close.

Pipeline, Forecasting & AI

  • Maintain a disciplined pipeline and deliver accurate, timely forecasts.
  • Maintain high-quality CRM data and use insights to prioritize accounts and opportunities.
  • Leverage AI and sales technologies to strengthen research, account planning, client engagement, and productivity.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional deal teams, bringing together the expertise needed to advance opportunities and deliver client value.
  • Partner across Client Success, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, and other teams as needed.
  • Share client, market, and competitive insights with Product and business leadership.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B software, SaaS, or technology sales experience
  • 5+ years in a closing role selling to strategic or enterprise accounts, or 2+ years selling Rithum solutions to enterprise clients, with quota attainment
  • Proven success in a full cycle quota carrying role; from strategic territory planning, prospecting, developing & closing complex 6 figure transactions (minimum 100k deal size)
  • Consistent recent quota attainment (100%+ for 4+ consecutive quarters) in a competitive, metrics-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated success developing and growing strategic accounts through new opportunities, expansion, cross-sell, upsell, or new use cases.
  • Experience leading complex sales cycles involving senior executives, multiple stakeholders, and commercial negotiations.
  • Mastery of structured, value-based sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC, Challenger, SPIN, Miller Heiman, Value Selling, Solution Selling) with evidence of pipeline progression and forecast accuracy, translating solutions into measurable business outcomes and leading cross-functional deal teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through self-generated outbound prospecting, with measurable activity standards (e.g., 40–60+ daily touchpoints)
  • Demonstrated ability to develop account plans, identify whitespace, build pipeline, and maintain accurate forecasts.
  • Disciplined use of CRM and sales tools (Salesforce preferred) and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, LinkedIn Navigator, ZoomInfo) for pipeline, activity, and conversion tracking.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, data, and modern sales technologies to improve sales effectiveness.
  • Ability to operate independently and travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of B2B SaaS, software, or technology sales experience.
  • Experience selling enterprise commerce, e-commerce, marketplace, retail technology, or related solutions.
  • Experience selling to large brands, retailers, manufacturers, or enterprises with complex buying environments.
  • Experience selling integrated solutions across multiple products, capabilities, or services.
  • Familiarity with partner- or channel-influenced sales motions.
  • Experience positioning data-driven or AI-powered solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.

Travel Required

Up to 25%

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

Benefits

  • Enhanced Private Medical Insurance and a Health Cash Back Plan
  • Life insurance & disability benefits
  • Pension plan with 4% Company match
  • Competitive time off package with 25 Days of PTO, 8 Company-paid Holidays, 2 paid floating holidays (new in 2026!), 10 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days and 1 Paid Volunteer Day
  • £45/month Remote work stipend for internet
  • Access to tools to support your wellbeing such as the Calm App and an Employee Assistance Program

  • Charitable contribution match per team member

Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law for qualified applicants. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form. Your comfort and accessibility are important to us, and we're here to ensure a seamless experience as you explore opportunities with our team.

title: Senior Website Manager
description:
Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote

 Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode!

 Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

 Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter .

 Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions.

 You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience.

 The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas.

 This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots.

 Key Responsibilities

• Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning.

• Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency.

• Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities.

• Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain.

• Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact.

• Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates.

• Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels.

• Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy.

• Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance.

• Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities.

• SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences.

• Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code.

• Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring.

• Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time.

• Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently.

• Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce).

• This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance.

 Required Skills & Qualifications

• 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth.

• Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation.

• Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar).

• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations).

• Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity.

• Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design).

• Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives.

• Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise.

• Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations.

• Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus.

 Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead

• Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy).

• Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page.

• Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture.

• Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression.

 Compensation Transparency:

 The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $125,000–$140,000, along with comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting.

 Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

 Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed

 At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

 Here’s our recruitment promise to you:

• Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.

• Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.

• Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address.

 From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

 Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 About the Role

 The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market.

 This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value.

 What You'll Do

• Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals.

• Accelerate the growth & adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles.

• Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements.

• Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors.

• Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion.

• Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles.

 Skills We're Looking For

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold multiple stakeholders accountable throughout a complex value-driven sales cycle.

• In-depth familiarity with the modern data technology industry and key players.

• You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

• You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment.

title: Manager, Customer Onboarding & Success
description:
Headquarters: Burlington, MA; Burlington, MA OR US Remote

 Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode!

 Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

 Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter .

 Veracode is seeking an experienced Manager, Customer Onboarding & Success to lead our customer onboarding function across Enterprise and commercial accounts — directly project managing technical deployments alongside Customer Solutions Engineers (CSEs), and ensuring customers achieve value quickly, adopt core capabilities, and are positioned for long-term success. This role directly reports to the Vice President of Customer Success.

 The ideal candidate brings a strong Customer Success background — building scalable programs in a B2B SaaS environment, hands-on experience project managing technical deployments, and leading enterprise onboarding teams. This person will own the customer journey across two segments: guided, high-touch onboarding for Enterprise accounts, where they will directly project manage deployments alongside CSEs and SAs; and a digital onboarding program for customers, delivering a high-quality experience at scale.

 Key Responsibilities

 Onboarding Leadership & Customer Experience

• Lead the onboarding function, managing and developing team members with clear accountability for customer outcomes, milestones, and exit criteria.

• Ensure onboarding plans translate purchased solutions into clear business outcomes, timelines, responsibilities, and adoption goals — with a focus on accelerating time to first value.

• Identify and resolve onboarding risks, stalled customers, and recurring friction points; establish standards for customer communication, stakeholder alignment, and governance.

 Technical Deployment Project Management

• Directly project manage customer deployments in partnership with CSEs and SAs — owning the end-to-end project plan, timeline, milestones, and customer-facing communication from post-sale through go-live.

• Define task ownership for technical resources with tracked deadlines, dependencies, and escalation paths; run deployment status meetings and drive blockers to resolution.

• Serve as the single point of accountability for the customer during deployment, translating technical activity into clear status, expectations, and next steps.

 Customer Success & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner with CS leadership, CSMs, and Sales to establish strong handoffs and ensure customers are positioned for long-term adoption, retention, and growth.

• Ensure CSMs receive complete onboarding documentation, customer goals, adoption status, outstanding risks, and agreed-upon next steps at transition.

• Work cross-functionally with Product and Support to identify and address systemic issues impacting the onboarding experience.

 Digital & Scaled Onboarding

• Own the strategy, design, and continuous improvement of tiered onboarding programs that align the customer experience to different levels of engagement and support — from digital and scaled experiences to guided, high-touch onboarding for Enterprise accounts. Incorporate self-service content, product walkthroughs, automated communications, and milestone checkpoints across each tier.

• Monitor engagement, completion, and time-to-value metrics; use data and customer feedback to continuously optimize onboarding experiences and ensure each program delivers the appropriate level of support.

 Program Management & Operational Excellence

• Establish governance, processes, and operating rhythms across the onboarding portfolio; develop reporting on performance, risks, capacity, and outcomes.

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and scalability; analyze trends to recommend improvements across the broader Customer Success organization.

 Success Metrics

• Onboarding completion rate and percentage of milestones completed on time

• Time to first value and product adoption within the first 90 days

• Customer satisfaction (CSAT) during onboarding

• Digital onboarding engagement, completion, and adoption rates

• Quality of onboarding-to-CSM handoffs and reduction in onboarding-related escalations

 Qualifications

• 7+ years in Customer Success, customer onboarding, or a related post-sale SaaS function, including 2+ years managing customer-facing teams; prior experience as or leading CSMs strongly preferred.

• Direct experience project managing technical customer deployments alongside technical resources (e.g., CSEs, SAs, or implementation engineers), ideally within an Enterprise or mid-market SaaS environment.

• Demonstrated understanding of the SaaS customer lifecycle and the relationship between onboarding, adoption, retention, and growth.

• Excellent customer communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive accountability across internal and external teams.

• Demonstrated success driving customer adoption, value realization, and business outcomes in a SaaS environment.

• Familiarity with CS platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero) and project or onboarding management tools; experience with digital onboarding tools (e.g., Pendo, WalkMe, Appcues) strongly preferred.

• Experience in B2B SaaS; cybersecurity or enterprise software experience is a plus.

 What we offer yo u:

• Outstanding Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs.

• Wellness benefits to help you focus on what’s most important.

• “Take What You Need” time off policy.

• Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode.

• Generous 401k match to help save for your future.

• Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day.

 Compensation Transparency:

 The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $110,000–$130,000, performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting.

 Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

 Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed

 At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

 Here’s our recruitment promise to you:

• Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.

• Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.

• Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address.

 If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action.

title: MSP Mac Help Desk Guru (work from home)
description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com

 URL: https://ignitionit.com

 Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first

 TL;DR

 ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.

 We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.

 What the actual job???

 Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”

 You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.

 In a typical week, you might:

•
 Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.

•
 Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.

•
 Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.

•
 Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.

•
 Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."

 ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.

 About ignitionit.com

 We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!

 What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.

 We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

 If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance.

 The tech you'll work with (and grow into)

 Day one, you'll be living in:

•
 Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more)

•
 Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows

•
 Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles

•
 Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends)

•
 Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client

•
 The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling

 ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open.

 Who we hope you are

 The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you:

•
 Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both)

•
 Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband

•
 Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem

•
 Have at least 5 years of IT support experience on the job.

 ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who:

•
 Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people

•
 Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time

•
 Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it

•
 Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line

•
 Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former

•
 Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine)

•
 Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application)

•
 Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously

 Regarding AI

 Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive.

 Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you.

 Compensation & logistics

•
 Base salary: Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk.

•
 Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones.

•
 Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet.

 How to apply

 The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how:

•
 Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works.

•
 If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items.

•
 From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment.

 If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different?

 Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you!

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-msp-mac-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

Autodesk Consulting is looking for a Business Consultant to join our Northern Europe team. This remote role is based in the Netherlands and supports strategic customers across the region.

This is a senior individual contributor role combining business consulting, AECO industry expertise and executive advisory. You’ll work with some of Autodesk’s largest customers to shape transformation strategies, define target operating models, and develop business cases and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

You’ll advise senior leaders, structure complex business challenges and lead strategic advisory engagements from discovery through executive decision-making. While you won’t configure or implement solutions, you’ll understand how Autodesk and complementary technologies fit within customers’ broader business and technology ecosystems, partnering with technical specialists to turn strategy into actionable delivery plans.

  • Understand customer objectives, challenges and operating context to define outcome-driven transformation strategies

  • Strong understanding of operating models, organizational change, governance, business cases and benefits realization

  • Ability to lead through influence across cross-functional and international teams, with excellent communication and executive presentation skills

location: Leeds, Yorkshire and the Humber, GB
description:
About the Role

4 hours on Saturday (term time only)

Leeds Junior Conservatoire is recruiting for a Tutor - Vocal studies & industry insights

We are looking for an enthusiastic musician-educator to work across a range of classes including Music Theory & Practical Musicianship, Leeds Junior Conservatoire Experience Band and Composition, helping students to deepen their understanding of music whilst developing their creativity, collaborative skills and musical confidence.

Leeds Junior Conservatoire (LJC) is a thriving community of young musicians, creators and performers from across Yorkshire and the North, offering exceptional opportunities for students aged 8–18 to develop their musical skills and creativity.

At LJC, we foster an inclusive, supportive environment where every young person can thrive. As part of our collaborative team of passionate educators and industry professionals, you will help nurture artistic ambition, self-expression and a lifelong love of music.

(Hourly rate is inclusive of prep time and holiday pay)

What You Will Do

As part of this role, you will teach across four areas of our programme:

Vocal Skills

Develop students' core singing technique through work on breath control, vocal health, tone production, musicianship, stylistic awareness and performance confidence. Students explore a variety of contemporary and commercial repertoire while building strong vocal foundations.

Musical Theatre Singing

Support students to develop the specialist skills required for musical theatre performance, combining vocal technique with storytelling, interpretation, characterisation and stagecraft. Students explore repertoire from a range of musical theatre styles and eras.

Advanced Vocals

Work with experienced and committed young singers to refine advanced vocal technique, artistry and performance practice. Students are encouraged to develop their own artistic identity, interpret challenging repertoire and prepare for future musical study and performance opportunities.

Industry Insights

Introduce students to the wide range of careers and opportunities within the music and performing arts industries. Through discussion, practical activities and guest insights where appropriate, students gain a greater understanding of the skills, pathways and professional expectations of working as a contemporary artist, vocalist or performer.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a practitioner who is passionate about vocal education and helping young people discover their creative potential through singing and performance.

You will:

  • Deliver engaging, inclusive and differentiated teaching for students aged 8–18, fostering creativity, confidence and musical independence.

  • Monitor student progress, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to curriculum development, assessment and teaching administration.

  • Collaborate with colleagues to support student success, maintain high teaching standards, and contribute to performances, open days and other LJC events.

About You

  • A degree in Music, Vocal Performance, Musical Theatre, Music Education or a related subject, with expertise in vocal performance and vocal pedagogy.
  • Experience teaching or working with young people under 18, including students of mixed abilities and those with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND).
  • Strong communication, organisation and classroom management skills, with the ability to facilitate engaging group learning and performance activities.
  • A commitment to inclusive music and performing arts education, ensuring all students can participate, develop their skills and achieve their potential.
  • A commitment to safeguarding young people and promoting equality, diversity and inclusion.
  • Availability to work on Saturdays during term time.
  • Desirable - Professional experience as a vocalist, musical theatre performer, vocal coach or music educator, including experience preparing students for auditions, performances or progression to further musical study, supported by a recognised teaching qualification, relevant continuing professional development, or current knowledge of the music and performing arts industries.


Any offer of employment will be made subject to an enhanced DBS check, which will be sought by the LJC for the successful applicant.

Windsor Forest Colleges Group is looking for a Lecturer in English to join our Slough & Langley College team on a permanent, part-time basis working on a 0.5 FTE. The salary for this role ranges from T1 £16,607.50 to T11 £23,804.50 (T1 £33,215 to T11 £47,609 FTE), depending on qualifications and experience.

As a Lecturer in English, you will be joining our Ofsted Rated Good Colleges Group delivering high quality English teaching at our Slough and Langley College campus. Your role focuses on supporting post-16 learners to develop their reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills, enabling successful achievement of GCSE or Functional Skills qualifications.

In partnership with Learning Support Assistants, you will create an inclusive and supportive classroom environment, adapting teaching strategies to meet diverse learner needs. Using diagnostic data, you will identify gaps in learning, set and monitor individual targets, and deliver focused interventions to support progress. Your collaborative approach will play a key role in improving attendance, retention and achievement, enabling all learners to reach their full potential.

Please pay particular attention to the supporting statement of the application, making sure to include details of how you meet each of the essential criteria listed on the person specification.

title: Technical Tutor - Electrical
description:
Windsor Forest Colleges Group is looking for a full time, permanent Electrical Technical Tutor to join our Slough & Langley College team in the Apprenticeships department. The salary ranges from £43,151 (L34) up to £46,374 (L37) per annum on the support staff pay scale, depending on experience and qualifications.

In this role, you will manage a caseload of apprentices, delivering high quality training, skills coaching and mentoring to ensure successful completion towards their End Point Assessment Gateway. You will work closely with apprentices, employers and internal support teams to track progress, monitor off-the-job training and deliver an outstanding apprenticeship experience.

We are looking for someone with relevant industry qualifications (including 18th Edition and AM2/AM2S), a recognised teaching qualification (such as CET, DET, or DTLLS), and an Assessor Award (A1 or equivalent). Above all, you will be driven by a genuine passion for inspiring the next generation of electricians and helping every apprentice reach their full potential.

Please pay particular attention to the supporting statement of the application, making sure to include details of how you meet each of the essential criteria listed on the person specification.

title: Programme Lead – Plumbing & Gas
description:
Windsor Forest Colleges Group is seeking an experienced Plumbing & Gas professional with proven team leadership experience to lead and develop our Plumbing & Gas apprenticeship provision within the Apprenticeships Department. This is an excellent opportunity for an established industry professional, experienced assessor or team leader looking to take ownership of a specialist training provision and drive high standards of delivery, quality and learner achievement.

Based at our Slough & Langley College campus, this full time, permanent position offers a salary between £47,456 (M38) and £50,701 (M41) on the Support Staff pay scale, depending on your experience and qualifications.

In this key leadership role, reporting to the Head of Apprenticeships, you will take operational responsibility for the quality, performance and continuous improvement of our Plumbing & Gas apprenticeship provision, leading and developing your team to ensure high standards of training and learner achievement.

Your responsibilities will span team management, curriculum planning, and standardisation, alongside monitoring learner progress to drive overall retention and achievement. You will also oversee quality assurance across the department by leading EQA visits, managing IQA processes, liaising with awarding bodies, and contributing to Self Assessment Reviews and Quality Improvement Plans.

Alongside your leadership responsibilities, you will train, coach and assess a caseload of apprentices against industry standards, conducting progress reviews, identifying at-risk learners and implementing timely interventions to support their success at End Point Assessment. You will also build strong relationships with local and national employers to ensure our curriculum meets industry needs.

We are seeking an experienced Plumbing & Gas professional with an appropriate vocational qualification or degree in Plumbing, Domestic Heating & Gas, alongside a recognised Assessor qualification (e.g. A1, TAQA, CAVA). You will have proven team leadership or coaching experience, a sound understanding of apprenticeship quality assurance, and experience using digital platforms for teaching, assessment and learner progress tracking. A Level 5 Teaching Qualification, or willingness to work towards one, is desirable.

Please pay particular attention to the supporting statement of the application, making sure to include details of how you meet each of the essential criteria listed on the person specification.

title: Programme Manager - Construction
description:
Windsor Forest Colleges group is looking for a Programme Manager in Construction to join our Slough and Langley College team on a permanent, full-time basis.

Reporting to the Curriculum Director, the Programme Manager in Construction combines classroom teaching and management responsibility. The role involves working 37 hours per week, with a timetable consisting of 18 contact teaching hours per week alongside 7 hours of administrative remission. It offers a salary on the Programme Managers pay scale from PM1 £41,256.00 up to PM7 £49,315.00 depending on Qualifications and Experience.

During the 18 contact teaching hours, the Programme Manager in Construction will teach both Plumbing and Carpentry disciplines on an equal split. Due to requirements to teach plumbing, candidates must hold a Level 3 qualification in Plumbing.

Operational duties include maintaining high standards of teaching, learning, and assessment, managing team performance through staff reviews, delivering key performance indicators, and driving student retention and achievement. The role also involves developing the curriculum offer to align with local building sector needs while utilising the college's dedicated trade workshops.

In addition to a level 3 qualification in plumbing, we are looking for a minimum Level 4 teaching qualification, and Level 2 qualifications in English and mathematics, a strong background in Further Education curriculum planning, and proficient digital and administrative skills, with assessor or verifier awards and leadership experience being advantageous.

The Programme Manager will actively foster relationships with employers, parents, and external stakeholders to secure valuable industry placements and expand commercial operations within the sector. Crucially, the postholder must demonstrate effective team leadership, a collaborative approach to continuous quality improvement, and a steadfast commitment to student safeguarding and inclusive learning.

Please pay particular attention to the supporting statement of the application, making sure to include details of how you meet each of the essential criteria listed on the person specification.

title: Deputy Head - School of Music and Education
location: Leeds, Yorkshire and the Humber, GB
description:
About the Role

Leeds Conservatoire is seeking an exceptional academic leader, educator and creative practitioner to join our senior leadership team as Deputy Head of School of Music.

This is a significant opportunity to influence the strategic direction of one of the UK's leading specialist conservatoires. Working closely with the Head of School, you will provide leadership across a diverse portfolio including Classical Music, Jazz, Composition, Film, TV & Games Music, while playing a leading role in the continued expansion of our academic offer.

As the UK's largest multidisciplinary conservatoire, Leeds Conservatoire champions innovative, industry-connected arts education that prepares students for successful creative careers. As we expand our provision, including Music Education, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future curriculum, respond to the evolving needs of students and the creative sector, and inspire the next generation of performers, educators and creative professionals.

What You Will Do

As Deputy Head of School, you will contribute to the strategic, academic and operational leadership of the School, supporting excellence in teaching, learning, student experience and curriculum development.

You will work closely with Programme Leaders and academic colleagues to drive innovation across the portfolio while supporting the development of new programmes and pathways that reflect emerging opportunities within music and music education.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the strategic leadership and development of the School of Music.
  • Leading curriculum innovation and enhancement across multiple disciplines.
  • Playing a key role in the development of new academic provision, including Music Education.
  • Designing and developing new programmes and modules in response to sector and student demand.
  • Ensuring high standards of academic quality, student outcomes and educational experience.
  • Supporting and developing academic teams through effective leadership and collaboration.
  • Building relationships with schools, industry partners, professional bodies and the wider education sector.
  • Contributing to student recruitment, external engagement and institutional initiatives.

About You

We are looking for an ambitious and forward-thinking academic leader with a passion for music education and curriculum innovation with:

  • Significant experience within higher education, conservatoire education or a related educational setting.
  • A strong understanding of music performance, composition, production and/or music education.
  • Experience of curriculum design, validation and programme development.
  • A track record of leading academic teams and managing change.
  • Knowledge of quality assurance and regulatory requirements within higher education.
  • A commitment to inclusive education, student success and educational excellence.
  • The vision and creativity to develop new opportunities that respond to the evolving music and education sectors.

title: Cleaner
description:
We are recruiting a school cleaner to join our professional site team. We are looking for a reliable and conscientious colleague, who will take pride in the appearance of the school and provide a clean and tidy environment for our students, staff and lettings.

Experience in school cleaning is useful but not essential and using cleaning machines and cleaning products would be an advantage, although training will be provided for the successful applicant. Common sense and the ability to be self-motivated is essential. You will need to work as part of a team under the direction of the Cleaning Manager.

Working hours are 15:15 -18:30, Monday to Friday, total 16.25 hours per week.

Working as part of our dedicated team, duties will include vacuuming, polishing, emptying bins, toilet cleaning etc. You must be able to use your own initiative and be motivated to work in an educational setting with children. Experience is desirable but full training will be given.

Specific Duties

  1. To undertake as required appropriate training in the use of equipment and chemicals used.
  2. Provide a comprehensive cleaning service to include dusting, vacuuming, washing floors, emptying bins etc. to ensure high standards of cleanliness and hygiene at all times.
  3. Removal of graffiti from reach heights daily as required.
  4. Wiping of skirting boards and walls daily.
  5. Collection and disposal of rubbish to designated areas.
  6. Maintain clean toilets to ensure hygiene standards are met. Mop floors daily.
  7. Ensure grounds are kept free from rubbish and debris so a clean and tidy site is maintained at all times.
  8. To replenish hand towels, hand soap and toilet roll as required.
  9. Report any premises or equipment defects to a senior caretaker.
  10. Undertake, if working during School Holiday shutdowns, a complete “deep clean” of all areas. Including window cleaning, moving furniture to clean, behind radiators, outside areas etc.

Please complete the application form to apply for the position.

In addition to providing the highest standards of teaching and learning, the priority of the Academy is the safety and welfare of its students. Therefore all staff undergo an enhanced DBS investigation and full references will be taken.

title: RLT Fundraising Officer
description:
This is a hands-on role where you will have the opportunity to build your fundraising experience and make a

real contribution to the River Learning Trust’s (RLT) ability to increase funding for key educational priorities

and initiatives. You will also be helping to build the culture of philanthropy across the RLT community,

managing resources, administration, and communications across the network.

You will be pivotal in researching and applying for funding from grant-making bodies, and also supporting

the freelance fundraising consultant to build meaningful relationships with potential donors, local

businesses, and other stakeholder groups.

You will also be responsible for managing the day-to-day running and support of the Trust-wide CRM

fundraising database, Beacon, ensuring best practice, alongside developing, and supporting the user base

across the school network.

Working with our freelance fundraising consultant, and reporting into the Trust’s CFO, the medium- to long-

term goal is to ensure that the Trust continues to build a strong and dynamic fundraising community,

alongside increasing the amount of philanthropic income used to support important areas of educational

need.

What skills / experience are required

We’re looking for someone with at least one year’s experience in a fundraising role who is organised,

enthusiastic, and confident building relationships. We need someone who can work independently,

proactively, and to a high standard, but also enjoys working collaboratively with the rest of the team and

wider staff network. You need to understand and be demonstrably competent using a CRM database, and

other relevant software, as well as writing clear and engaging funding applications and communications.

What we can offer

You will have the opportunity to build your fundraising knowledge and skill-set, in a casual, yet supportive

environment, working alongside our experienced fundraising consultant, and other established fundraising

professionals across the network. The post-holder will be expected to develop and drive several important

projects over the medium- to long-term, and do so by working flexibly across the week, during term time.

Education has the power to change lives, communities, and society for the better. At RLT we believe that we

can achieve more for our pupils, trainees, staff, and communities by working together rather than alone.

Schools in RLT are united by a common belief in the benefits of working together, and by our commitment to

shared principles.

OUR VISION is for our schools and SCITT to improve rapidly, continuously, and sustainably: to be better

faster together.

OUR ‘WHY?’ is that children and young people ‘only get one go’ in school and therefore as part of RLT we

aim to ensure the best possible ‘go’ for our pupils.

OUR ‘HOW?’ is through the highest support and challenge for our schools and each other, underpinned by

our principles.

Our employees benefit from a wide variety of support including extensive continuing professional learning

and development opportunities, wellbeing and staff networks and access to Defined Benefit Pension

Schemes (TPS and LGPS) for all staff. ,For more information on what it is like to work for the Trust, and the

benefits you could access, please see our “Working in RLT” guide.

This role includes regulated activity relevant to children.

If you would like to have a confidential chat with Ali James about the role, prior to application, then please

email: ajames@riverlearningtrust.org, to arrange a call.

The River Learning Trust is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all children and

preventing extremism. The Trust is required to conduct a variety of checks and online searches about you

as part of their recruitment process in accordance with Keeping Children Safe in Education guidance. It is an

offence to apply for certain roles within schools if you are barred from engaging in regulated activity relevant

to children. The River Learning Trust is an equal opportunities employer committed to creating a safe,

inclusive environment for all staff, free from discrimination and harassment.

title: Resourcing & Talent Development Assistant
description:
About Excalibur Academies Trust

Founded in 2012, Excalibur Academies Trust has grown from two schools in Marlborough, Wiltshire, to 20 schools reaching from Bristol to Reading along the M4 corridor, providing high-quality education to 10,000 children from 9 months to age 18.

Our vision is to provide an all-through education in local hubs, with a focus on the best teaching, a broad and exciting curriculum and an outward-facing global perspective. We believe in investing in our staff to ensure we attract and retain talented, dedicated people who are committed to changing children’s lives for the better.

With a strong track record of raising the achievement of disadvantaged pupils across the trust, it is our mission to promote social mobility and personal fulfilment through the transformative power of education. Our growth strategy is based on our hub model and building the capacity to provide strong support and opportunities to other schools who share our vision.

The Role

This role can be based in Swindon, Wiltshire or Bristol

Are you organised, proactive and passionate about delivering excellent customer service? We are seeking a Resourcing & Talent Development Assistant to play a key role in attracting and welcoming talented colleagues across our academies.

Working closely with academies, candidates and the People Team, you will support recruitment campaigns, onboarding and safer recruitment processes, ensuring pre-employment checks are completed efficiently and statutory requirements are met.

You will maintain accurate records, coordinate recruitment administration and contribute to talent initiatives and continuous improvement.

We are looking for someone with excellent organisational and communication skills, strong attention to detail and a customer-focused approach. Experience in recruitment or HR administration is desirable, but transferable skills and a willingness to learn are equally valued.

If you are enthusiastic about people and ready to make a difference, we would love to hear from you!

Please see the attached Job Description for full details of the responsibilities and expectations of this role.

Please check the Person Specification for the qualifications that are listed as Essential for this role. You will be required to show these qualifications if you are successful.

Benefits

Hybrid/Flexible working based in Swindon, Wiltshire or Bristol

Support on Continuous Professional Development (CPD)

Excellent Pension Scheme (LGPS for Shared Services staff)

Employee Assistance Programme

Free on-site parking & Cycle to Work Scheme

Free Eye Tests

Career development opportunities across the Trust

Flexible Family Friendly Policies

Note: Applicants will be considered as received. Should a suitable candidate be identified, we may close the vacancy early.

In the first instance we would welcome your application via My New Term. However, if you are unable to complete the application on this platform, please contact the team using recruitment@excalibur.org.uk and we will be able to issue a Word version of the application form for completion and return by the deadline. Unfortunately, in line with Safer Recruitment, we are unable to accept CVs.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the Chief Operating Officer will provide strategic leadership across our operational services, ensuring our systems, infrastructure and resources enable our academies to thrive and support the Trust's long-term ambitions.

This is a wide-ranging executive leadership role, with responsibility for estates and infrastructure, digital and technology, commercial development, marketing and communications, risk, compliance and operational assurance. You will lead the development and delivery of our operational strategy, ensuring our services are effective, sustainable and aligned with our educational priorities.

Working closely with the CEO, fellow executive colleagues, academy leaders and Trustees, you will translate strategic priorities into clear operational plans, drive organisational improvement and strengthen accountability across the Trust. You will oversee major capital projects, champion digital innovation, identify opportunities for sustainable income generation and ensure robust arrangements for risk management, business continuity and regulatory compliance.

You will also lead and empower our operational teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement. Through effective resource management, strong governance and a focus on value for money, you will help build the resilient foundations needed to support our academies and the communities they serve.

This is an exciting opportunity to influence Trust-wide strategy, lead significant organisational change and make a lasting difference to the educational experiences and outcomes of children and young people.

About you

You will be an accomplished senior operational leader with significant experience working across multiple functions within a complex, multi-site organisation. You will bring the strategic vision, professional credibility and leadership capability to operate effectively at executive level, balancing long-term organisational priorities with effective operational delivery.

You will have a proven track record of developing and implementing strategic plans, leading organisational change, managing significant budgets and resources, and delivering large-scale projects and programmes. You will understand the importance of robust governance, risk management, compliance and assurance, and be confident providing clear, evidence-based reporting to senior leaders, Trustees and external stakeholders.

An effective and collaborative leader, you will be skilled at building relationships, influencing stakeholders and leading diverse professional teams. You will empower colleagues, establish clear accountability and create an environment in which people are supported to develop, innovate and deliver excellent outcomes.

You will bring sound judgement, resilience and a commitment to continuous improvement, alongside an understanding of how digital transformation, sustainable estate management and efficient operational services can support organisational performance. Experience within the education sector or a Multi-Academy Trust would be advantageous, as would experience of organisational growth, mergers or digital transformation.

Above all, you will share our commitment to educational excellence and recognise that effective operational leadership plays a vital role in enabling our pupils, colleagues and academies to succeed.

How to apply

For further information about the role or guidance on the application process, interested candidates are encouraged to contact our recruitment partners, Propelo, in the first instance.

Telephone: 01273 222 877

title: Senior Financial Crime Investigator, Business Banking
description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

UK Remote | £31,100 - £39,350 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

Start date: Monday 18th January, 2027

⭐ About our Senior Financial Crime Business Banking Investigator Team

The Senior Financial Crime Business Banking Investigator team serves as Monzo’s frontline defence against complex economic crime, safeguarding our ecosystem and customers, from startups to established SMEs, against sophisticated fraud and money laundering. Operating within a specialised, risk-focused "Pillar," this critical operational team builds deep subject matter expertise to ensure financial integrity across the entire customer lifecycle. The team is responsible for conducting rigorous onboarding and ongoing compliance checks, unravelling complex financial crime typologies, and directly mitigating risk through thorough investigation, reporting, and account closures.

You’ll play a key role by...

  • Taking ownership of the most complex FinCrime Business Banking tasks, including Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) for high-risk businesses, Complex Customer Reviews (e.g., sensitive areas like Sexual Services flags), and multi-jurisdictional money muling investigations.
  • Writing, reviewing, and submitting high-quality Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) to the National Crime Agency (NCA), ensuring they meet the highest legal and evidential standards.
  • Maintaining a regular schedule on core investigative tasks to sustain your competency levels, directly support the domain’s Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and remain connected to frontline challenges.
  • Actively coaching Investigators on complex financial crime typologies, best practice, and performance improvement to help drive a culture of excellence.
  • Working closely with our Operations Analysts to share emerging trends and ensure that operational guidance is continuously updated and effectively embedded across the domain.

We’d love to hear from you if...

  • You have deep KYB & AML expertise, with significant experience conducting end-to-end business due diligence (KYB/EDD) and complex investigations within a regulated financial setting.
  • You are a skilled researcher, with a proven ability to leverage open-source intelligence and analysis to thoroughly corroborate customer profiles and transactional activity.
  • You know regulations and typologies, possessing a strong grasp of UK and international financial crime trends affecting business accounts and the UK SAR regime.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, maintaining high flexibility and adapting positively to shifting priorities, new guidance, and process changes at short notice.
  • You are impact-driven, with a genuine desire to protect Monzo and its customers by making a tangible difference in the detection and prevention of financial crime.
  • You bring leadership and improvement skills, ideally with experience mentoring peers, a track record of escalating process improvements, or a relevant qualification (such as ICA or ACAMS).

⏰ Shifts you’ll be working

You will work 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, from 9:00am to 5:30pm. You will also work one full weekend (Saturday and Sunday) once every 4 weeks, with 2 set days in lieu provided when working the weekend shift.

We cannot approve any time off during your first 6 weeks of employment with us due to training. Your training will be held Monday-Friday, 9am-5:30pm.

What’s in it for you

Salary range of £31,100 - £39,350 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

We guarantee to approve time off on your birthday if it falls on a scheduled work day (outside of your training period).

This role is fully remote and based within the UK.

A £1,000 annual budget to spend on books, training courses, and conferences.

We will set you up for success from home; all employees are provided with MacBooks, and fully remote workers receive extra support for their work-from-home environment.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

The application journey has 3 key steps

  1. Application questions – Please take the time to answer these, as we read every single one.
  2. Recruiter call – A 30-minute video call to assess skills fit
  3. Hiring Manager interview – A 60-minute video call focusing on values and technical questions.

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.
